Committee: Health

Date: 03/09/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 480 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama State Board of Occupational Therapy by an undetermined amount to develop a program to promote early identification, intervention, treatment, and rehabilitation of any impaired licensee and to provide operational expenses, including actual cost of travel, office overhead, and personnel expenses of members of the Alabama Occupational Therapy Wellness Committee created by this bill.
Paul W. Lee, Chair
Health
